descriptionHtml:
WiNavigate is an event successfully held on April 29th, 2025, from 10:35 AM to 11:25 AM. It featured a powerful and inspiring session by Ms. Anjali Budawatta Jayawardana on Leadership Empowerment for Emerging Women. The event is organized by the IEEE Women in Engineering Affinity Group of Sri Lanka in collaboration with the IEEE Women in Engineering Student Branch Affinity Group of the University of Peradeniya.

Ms. Anjali’s dynamic and engaging talk was more than just a discussion, it was a moment of awakening for all participants. She asked questions that encouraged active participation and self-reflection. Speaking with authenticity, strength, and grace, she challenged traditional norms and inspired the audience to embrace leadership with courage, empathy, and conviction. Her presence and words resonated with the young women in the audience, motivating them to believe in their potential. As a truly inspiring figure, Ms. Anjali left a lasting impact, reminding every participant that the journey to leadership begins from within.
venue: Electrical and Electronic Engineering Department., Seminar room, Elementary Laboratory., Faculty of Engineering,
